_comment: Copy to longhaul.json in pi's agent dir (~/.pi/agent, or PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR). Every key is optional; the defaults are in config.ts. model (omitted here on purpose): provider/model-id to route the narrative call off the session's own model; unset, every session summarizes on its own model, and PI_COMPACT_STATE_MODEL overrides for one invocation. routeProviders: provider names, matched exactly, whose sessions may use that route; every other session summarizes on its own model (none by default, so a model alone routes nothing). localOnlyRoots: directories (absolute, or ~/...; on Windows C:\... or ~\... too) whose sessions, and their subdirectories', never use the route, so their conversation stays on the session's own model; only PI_COMPACT_STATE_MODEL beats it, and an entry that cannot match warns. summarizerHeaders: {provider: {header: template}} added to the compaction's own model calls, which pi's before_provider_headers event never sees (e.g. a session-affinity header for a provider that routes by it); {sessionId} is the pi session id, a header the provider already sets wins, empty by default. keptWindowThinking (omitted here on purpose): unset, the kept window's old thinking is left out of requests only on APIs where that is verified (openai-completions); "keep" never strips; "strip" strips on any API, leaving an active tool turn whole where the API needs its thinking back. caps: hard cap on the rendered state and per-section caps. claimPatterns: leading-token patterns that turn a ledger command into a World claim. rememberPerSpan: accepted longhaul_remember writes per span. coldSliceCaps: command/error records kept per span record. nearDuplicateThreshold: token overlap at or above which a new item is a duplicate. narrativePolicy: retries, chunking, the output budget and the per-request timeout of the narrative call. narrativeMode: single (one diff call) or turns (one section per turn, opt-in); the turns tuning block narrativeTurns is experimental, not part of the versioning contract, and left out here.
